dn14:1.15.5: iccheyyātha no tumhe bhikkhave bhiyyoso mattāya pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotunti.
dn14:1.15.6: etassa bhagavā kālo etassa sugata kālo
dn14:1.15.7: yaṃ bhagavā bhiyyoso mattāya pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
dn14:1.15.8: tenahi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
dn14:1.15.9: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn14:1.16.1: ito so bhikkhave ekanavuto kappo yaṃ vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.16.2: vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi khattiyakule udapādi.
dn14:1.16.3: vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.16.4: vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asītivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.16.5: vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.16.6: vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khaṇḍatissaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.

dn14:1.16.8: eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni.
dn14:1.16.9: vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.16.10: vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.16.11: vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi
dn14:1.16.12: bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janettī
dn14:1.16.13: bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.17.1: athakho bhikkhave vipassī bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātu kucchiṃ okkami.
dn14:1.17.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkamati.
dn14:1.17.4: atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo oḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.5: yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakāra timisā yatthapime candimasuriyā evaṃmahiddhikā evaṃmahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti tatthapi appamāṇo oḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.6: yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhupapannāti.
dn14:1.17.7: ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedheti appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.9: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti cattāro devaputtā cātuddisaṃ rakkhāya upa gacchanti mā naṃ bodhisattaṃ vā bodhisattamātaraṃ vā manusso vā amanusso vā koci viheṭhesīti.
dn14:1.18.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti pakatiyā sīlavatī bodhisattamātā hoti viratā pāṇātipātā viratā adinnādānā viratā kāmesumicchācārā viratā musāvādā viratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā.
dn14:1.19.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti na bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāmaguṇupasaṃhitaṃ anatikkamaniyā va bodhisattamātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittena.
dn14:1.20.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti lābhinī bodhisattamātā hoti pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ. sā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricāreti.
dn14:1.21.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
dn14:1.21.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave maṇiveḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno sabbākārasampanno tatrassa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitakaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā
dn14:1.21.3: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthesu karitvā paccavekkheyya ayaṃ kho maṇiveḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno sabbākārasampanno tatrassa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitakaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā
dn14:1.21.4: evameva kho bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
dn14:1.22.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave sattāhajāte bodhisatte bodhisattamātā kālaṃ karoti tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjati.
dn14:1.23.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yathā aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti na hevaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati. daseva māsāni bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyati.

dn14:1.27.1: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati visado va nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visuddho.

dn14:1.27.5: evameva kho bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikakhamati visado va nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visuddho.

dn14:1.34.1: athakho bhikkhave bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa dhātiyo upaṭṭhāpesi.
dn14:1.34.2: aññā khīraṃ pāyenti aññā nhāpenti aññā dhārenti aññā aṅkena pariharanti.
dn14:1.34.3: jātassa kho pana bhikkhave vipassissa kumārassa setacchattaṃ dhārayittha divā ceva rattiṃ ca
dn14:1.34.4: mā naṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā tiṇaṃ vā rajo vā ussāvo vāti.
dn14:1.34.5: jāto kho pana bhikkhave vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
dn14:1.34.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā bahuno janassa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
dn14:1.34.7: evameva kho bhikkhave vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
dn14:1.35.1: jāto kho pana bhikkhave vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemanīyassaro ca.
dn14:1.35.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave himavante pabbate karavikā nāma sakuṇajāti mañjussarā ca vaggussarā ca madhurassarā ca pemanīyassarā ca
dn14:1.35.3: evameva kho bhikkhave vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemanīyassaro ca.
dn14:1.36.1: jātassa kho pana bhikkhave vipassissa kumārassa kammavipākajaṃ dibbacakkhuṃ pāturahosi yena dūraṃ samantā yojanaṃ passati divā ceva rattiṃ ca.
dn14:1.37.1: jāto kho pana bhikkhave vipassī kumāro animmissanto pekkhati seyyathāpi bhikkhave devatā tāvatiṃsā
dn14:1.37.2: animmissantā pekkhanti evameva kho bhikkhave vipassī kumāro animmissanto pekkhati. jātassa kho pana bhikkhave vipassissa kumārassa vipassītveva samaññā udapādi.
dn14:1.37.3: athakho bhikkhave bandhumā rājā aṭṭakaraṇe nisinno vipassiṃ kumāraṃ aṅke nisīdāpetvā aṭṭe anusāsati.
dn14:1.37.4: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave vipassī kumāro pitu aṅke nisinno viceyya viceyya atthe panāyati ñāṇena.
dn14:1.37.5: viceyya viceyya kumāro aṭṭe panāyati ñāṇenāti. athakho bhikkhave vipassissa kumārassa bhiyyoso mattāya vipassītveva samaññā udapādi.
dn14:1.38.1: athakho bhikkhave bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa tayo pāsāde kārāpesi ekaṃ vassikaṃ ekaṃ hemantikaṃ ekaṃ gimhikaṃ
dn14:1.38.3: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave vipassī kumāro vassike pāsāde cattāro māse nippurisehi turiyehi paricārayamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohatīti.
dn14:2.1.1: athakho bhikkhave vipassī kumāro bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena sārathiṃ āmantesi
dn14:2.1.2: yojehi samma sārathi bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyāti.
dn14:2.1.3: evaṃ devāti kho bhikkhave sārathi vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojetvā vipassikumārassa paṭivedesi
dn14:2.1.4: yuttāni kho te deva bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni
dn14:2.1.6: athakho bhikkhave vipassī kumāro bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyāsi.
dn14:2.2.1: addasā kho bhikkhave vipassī kumāro uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto purisaṃ jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhaggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantaṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ
dn14:2.2.3: ayaṃ pana samma sārathi puriso kiṃkato
dn14:2.2.4: kesāpissa na yathā aññesaṃ kāyopissa na yathā aññesanti.
dn14:2.2.6: kiṃ paneso samma sārathi jiṇṇo nāmāti.
dn14:2.2.7: eso kho deva jiṇṇo nāma nadāni tena ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ bhavissatīti.
dn14:2.2.8: kiṃ pana samma sārathi ahaṃpi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatītoti.
dn14:2.2.9: tvañca deva mayañcamhā sabbe jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītāti.
dn14:2.2.10: tenahi samma sārathi alandānajja uyyānabhūmiyā ito ca antepuraṃ paccaniyyāhīti.
dn14:2.2.11: evaṃ devāti kho bhikkhave sārathi vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā tato ca antepuraṃ paccaniyyāsi.
dn14:2.2.12: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave vipassī kumāro antepuraṃ gato dukkhī dummano pajjhāyati
dn14:2.2.13: dhiratthu kira bho jāti nāma yatra hi nāma jātassa jarā paññāyissatīti.

dn14:2.3.2: kacci samma sārathi kumāro uyyānabhūmiyā abhiramittha kacci samma sārathi kumāro uyyānabhūmiyā attamano ahosīti

dn14:3.31.15: vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ
dn14:3.31.16: vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko
dn14:3.31.17: vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janettī
dn14:3.31.18: bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi
dn14:3.31.19: vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa evaṃ abhiknikkhamanaṃ ahosi evaṃ pabbajjā evaṃ padhānaṃ evaṃ abhisambodhi evaṃ dhammacakkappavattanaṃ
dn14:3.31.20: te mayaṃ mārisa vipassimhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmachandaṃ virājetvā idhupapannāti.
dn14:3.31.21: tasmiṃyeva kho bhikkhave devanikāye anekāni devatāsatāni anekāni devatāsahassāni yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ
dn14:3.31.22: ito so mārisa ekatiṃso kappo yaṃ sikhī bhagavā …pe…
dn14:3.31.23: te mayaṃ mārisa sikhimhi bhagavati …pe… tasmiṃyeva kho mārisa ekatiṃse kappe vessabhū bhagavā …pe…
dn14:3.31.25: imasmiṃyeva kho mārisa bhaddakappe kakusandho. konāgamano. kassapo bhagavā …pe…
dn14:3.31.26: te mayaṃ mārisa kakusandhamhi. konāgamanamhi. kassapamhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmachandaṃ virājetvā idhupapannāti.
dn14:3.32.1: tasmiṃyeva kho bhikkhave devanikāye anekāni devatāsatāni anekāni devatāsahassāni yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā devatā maṃ etadavocuṃ
dn14:3.32.2: imasmiṃyeva kho mārisa bhaddakappe bhagavā etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno
dn14:3.32.3: bhagavā mārisa khattiyo jātiyā khattiyakule uppanno
dn14:3.32.5: bhagavato mārisa appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo
dn14:3.32.7: bhagavato mārisa sārīputtamoggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ
dn14:3.32.8: bhagavato mārisa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni
dn14:3.32.9: bhagavato mārisa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ
dn14:3.32.10: bhagavato mārisa ānando nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko aggupaṭṭhāko
dn14:3.32.11: bhagavato mārisa suddhodano nāma rājā pitā
dn14:3.32.14: bhagavato mārisa evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi evaṃ pabbajjā evaṃ padhānaṃ evaṃ abhisambodhi evaṃ dhammacakkappavattanaṃ
dn14:3.32.15: te mayaṃ mārisa bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmachandaṃ virājetvā idhupapannāti.
dn14:3.33.1: iti kho bhikkhave tathāgatassevesā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati nāmatopi anussarati gottatopi anussarati āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati sāvakayugatopi anussarati sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi
dn14:3.33.2: evaṃnāmā. evaṃgottā. evaṃsīlā. evaṃdhammā. evaṃpaññā. evaṃvihārī. evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti.
dn14:3.33.3: devatāpi tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati nāmatopi anussarati gottatopi anussarati āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati sāvakayugatopi anussarati sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi
dn14:3.33.4: evaṃnāmā. evaṃgottā. evaṃsīlā. evaṃdhammā. evaṃpaññā. evaṃvihārī. evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti.
dn14:3.33.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
